data.name: Muniraju
data.gender_notes: Muniraju is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muniraju is a name of Lord Rama, derived from the Sanskrit words 'muni' meaning sage and 'raja' meaning king. It signifies a wise and powerful ruler. The name Muniraju carries the meaning “Lord of the Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muniraju usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes reverence and respect, symbolizing a spiritual leader or a wise and virtuous king.
data.etymology: Muniraju belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muniraju total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
